CHANGE: New server/src/features/jobs/sources/atsPublic/connectors/workable.ts: GET https://apply.workable.com/api/v1/widget/accounts/{slug}?details=true (answered without a key in the 2026-10-11 probe: 6 jobs with description, published_on, telecommuting, country, city, shortcode, application_url). Map: externalId '<slug>:<shortcode>', title, descriptionHtml = description, applyUrl = application_url (fall back to the posting URL apply.workable.com/<slug>/j/<shortcode>), location from city / state / country with the stated country binding, workModel 'remote' only when telecommuting is true, postedAt = published_on (a date without time: midnight UTC, postedAtEstimated false), company = the source's name. No pay field was seen: none is mapped. Workable does not document this endpoint for third parties, so it has its own kill switch ATS_WORKABLE_DISABLED (default off, i.e. the connector is on) and the question is listed for the owner; the connector reads one listing per board per sync like the others and identifies itself with the User-Agent. Record the fixture from the documented field list of the probe (no posting text is stored in the repo beyond a short synthetic body).

[P1] Recruitee and Personio connectors (JI-8; INTL note 4.4)
CHANGE: New server/src/features/jobs/sources/atsPublic/connectors/recruitee.ts: GET https://{company}.recruitee.com/api/offers/ (the Careers Site API that needs no authorisation). Map offers: externalId '<company>:<id>', title, descriptionHtml (description plus requirements when the payload separates them), applyUrl = the offer's careers URL, location / city / country as stated, remote flag as stated, employment type as stated, postedAt = published_at, pay only when min / max / currency fields are present. New server/src/features/jobs/sources/atsPublic/connectors/personio.ts: GET https://{company}.jobs.personio.de/xml?language=en (a tenant on the .com host is stored with the token 'com:<company>' resolved by the connector to {company}.jobs.personio.com); parse with the XML reader: each position -> externalId '<company>:<id>', title = name, description = the jobDescriptions sections joined (CDATA), office / department, employmentType and schedule as stated, postedAt = createdAt, applyUrl = https://{company}.jobs.personio.de/job/<id> (the tenant's own job page). Personio states no pay: none is mapped. A redirect (what a non-customer host returns) is a hard failure 'redirect', never followed. Field names for both payloads must be confirmed against the vendors' documentation cited in INTL note 12 (Recruitee offers reference, Personio XML support article) before coding; the fixtures are built from those documented samples and marked with the doc date.
ACCEPT: The Recruitee and Personio parts of JI-8's 'Accepted when': each fixture board produces normalised rows with apply URL and dates (and pay where the Recruitee fixture gives it); a Personio redirect fails the read without closing anything; HTML and CDATA text come out as plain description text through the normalizer; both connectors report complete listings so closure works.

[P1] Lever EU host; Greenhouse pay ranges and application deadline (JI-8; strategy 1.5 closure; INTL note 4.4, 7.2)
CHANGE: (1) Lever EU: tenants on Lever's EU instance answer on api.eu.lever.co. Add ats 'lever_eu' whose connector is the existing lever connector with that base URL (server/src/features/jobs/sources/atsPublic/connectors.ts lever, 227-250; factor the base host into a parameter) and whose apply links are on jobs.eu.lever.co; rows are written with sourceBoard 'lever_eu' so two tenants with the same site name on the two instances cannot collide; the display name is 'Lever'. Also map Lever's salaryRange / salaryDescription as today. (2) Greenhouse (server/src/features/jobs/sources/atsPublic/connectors.ts mapGreenhouseJob, 145-167, and the list call at 171-181): request the listing with content=true&pay_transparency=true and map pay_input_ranges when a posting carries them: the first range with numeric bounds -> salaryMin / salaryMax (the API states cents: divide by 100), salaryCurrency = currency_type, salaryText = the range title when present; no range -> nothing (the normalizer still reads pay text from the description). Whether the list call returns the ranges is an open question in the research (INTL note 11 item 6): the mapper must work when the field is absent and must not add a per-posting request. Map application_deadline to expiresAt (MKT-J4 made a stated deadline binding for board rows); first_published stays the posting date. Confirm the two field names against docs.greenhouse.io/job-board.html and build the fixture from the documented sample.
ACCEPT: The Lever EU and Greenhouse parts of JI-8's 'Accepted when': a Lever EU fixture is requested from api.eu.lever.co and yields rows with sourceBoard 'lever_eu' and K2 keys 'lever_eu:<site>:<id>'; a Greenhouse fixture posting with a pay range of 12000000-15000000 cents USD yields 120,000-150,000 USD and one with application_deadline yields that expiresAt and is archived after it; a posting without either is unchanged from today.
TESTS: server/src/features/jobs/sources/atsPublic/atsPublic.test.ts: Lever EU URL and board, Greenhouse pay and deadline cases with an extended server/src/features/jobs/sources/atsPublic/__fixtures__/greenhouse.json.

[P1] 北森 connector, built and tested but off until counsel signs off (JC-8; strategy 1.4 tier 2, 7 item 14; CN note 4.4, 5.1, 6 tier 2, 8)
CHANGE: New server/src/features/jobs/sources/atsPublic/connectors/beisen.ts for tenant boards <tenant>.zhiye.com, registered only when CN_ATS_BEISEN_ENABLED is true (default false): with the flag off the ats id is rejected by create / import ('connector_disabled'), no host rule for zhiye.com exists, no request can be built and existing 北森 sources are skipped. With the flag on: POST https://<tenant>.zhiye.com/api/Jobad/GetJobAdPageList with a JSON body (paging; Category 1 = 社招, campus read as a second pass; DisplayFields for date, location and salary), no cookie, token or signature; add postJson to server/src/features/jobs/sources/atsPublic/http.ts restricted to this host pattern. Politeness and legal rules, each enforced in code: at most 2 北森 tenants in flight (a separate semaphore in server/src/features/jobs/ingest/boards.ts, the board sync MKT-J5 built, independent of ATS_BOARDS_CONCURRENCY); a floor of 30 minutes between two reads of the same tenant whatever the adaptive interval says (the lease skips a 北森 source whose lastSyncedAt is under 30 minutes old, and nextSyncAt is never set earlier than that); a hard cap of CN_ATS_BEISEN_MAX_POSTINGS_PER_RUN postings per tenant and run (default 200; a capped listing is incomplete and closes nothing); User-Agent sourceUserAgent('cn', env); never a login, a captcha answer or a computed signature (a response that asks for one is a hard failure); a tenant on CN_ATS_TENANT_DENYLIST (comma list) or disabled by an admin is never read and its rows are archived (the takedown path). Mapping: market cn only (a posting outside mainland China is dropped and counted); recruitment type 社招 / 校招 from the category that listed it; naive timestamps are UTC+8 and year 0001 means no date (MKT-J4's rule); pay as posted: a bare pair such as '35-57' is kept verbatim in salaryText and is not filterable; the field WorkWeChatQrCode and any recruiter phone or WeChat id are never stored (dropped in the mapper before the input is built, asserted by a test over the input's keys and text); applyUrl = the posting's page on the tenant board; sourcePublisher = '<company> · 北森'. The fixture is SYNTHETIC: hand-built only from the field names the research note cites, and its README says a real response must be recorded and the mapper re-verified by ops before the flag is ever turned on. Write docs/job-search/ATS_BOARDS.md: the rules above, the removal procedure for an employer's request (disable the source or add the tenant to the denylist; rows are archived at the next sync), and the statement that Moka (AES-wrapped responses) and 飞书招聘 (signed, captcha-gated) are not read.
ACCEPT: The 'Accepted when' of JC-8: off by default (with an empty env no zhiye.com request can be built, proven by assertApiHost and by the connector registry); with the flag on and fixtures a second read of the same tenant within 30 minutes is refused by the floor, never more than two tenants are read at once, a listing longer than the cap is marked incomplete and closes nothing, the QR field and phone numbers appear nowhere in the produced inputs, every row is market cn with an employer-board apply URL and a 来源 naming the employer and 北森; a denylisted tenant is skipped and its rows archived.
TESTS: server/src/features/jobs/sources/atsPublic/atsPublic.test.ts with server/src/features/jobs/sources/atsPublic/__fixtures__/beisen.json (synthetic): flag off and on, floor, in-flight limit (fake clock and a counting fake fetch), cap, never-stored fields, denylist.

bundles.title: Closure and freshness: on-demand liveness check, three date facts, mainland unseen rule, sponsorship label rule
items:
[P0] Liveness check against the ATS's documented single-posting endpoint (JI-10; strategy 1.5 closure; INTL note 7.2, 8.2 S5)
CHANGE: New server/src/features/jobs/liveness/ (index.ts, check.ts, check.test.ts). checkPostingLive(job, deps) -> { state: 'open' | 'closed' | 'unknown', checkedAt, via } for a row that has an atsPostingKey (MKT-J4) of one of the three ATSs whose public API documents a single-posting JSON endpoint: greenhouse -> GET https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/{token}/jobs/{id}; lever -> GET https://api.lever.co/v0/postings/{site}/{id} (lever_eu on api.eu.lever.co once MKT-J10 allows the host; until then unknown); smartrecruiters -> GET https://api.smartrecruiters.com/v1/companies/{id}/postings/{postingId}. Use getJson from server/src/features/jobs/sources/atsPublic/http.ts (allow-listed hosts, no redirects, identifying User-Agent) with a 4 s timeout. 200 with a posting -> open; 404 -> closed; anything else (timeout, 5xx, 429, unexpected shape) -> unknown. Never an HTML fetch, never a career-site page, never Workday or any ATS outside the table (those answer unknown without a request). The check applies to any provider's row that carries such a key (a JSearch row linking to Greenhouse included). Throttle: skip the request and answer from the row when lastSeenAt is under 6 hours old (LIVENESS_RECHECK_HOURS) or when an in-process LRU has an answer for the key younger than 10 minutes; at most one request per job per call. Effects, through one function applyLiveness(db, job, result): open -> set lastSeenAt = now (it is 'last confirmed listed'); closed -> archive the row (archivedAt, closedAt, closeReason 'source_removed') and run the dedupe repair for its key so an alternate becomes canonical; unknown -> no write. Kill switch LIVENESS_CHECK_DISABLED.
ACCEPT: A row keyed 'greenhouse:acme:1' whose endpoint answers 404 is reported closed and archived with closeReason source_removed; 200 refreshes lastSeenAt; a timeout or 500 reports unknown and writes nothing; a row seen 2 hours ago makes no request; a Workday-keyed row makes no request; the request URL is built only from the stored key (asserted) and goes only to the three hosts.
TESTS: server/src/features/jobs/liveness/check.test.ts with a fake fetch and fake db: per-ATS URL, status mapping, throttles, effects, kill switch.
FILES: server/src/features/jobs/liveness/index.ts (new), server/src/features/jobs/liveness/check.ts (new), server/src/features/jobs/liveness/check.test.ts (new)

[P0] Opening a job confirms it is still listed and shows "closed" instead of a dead link (JI-10; strategy 1.5)
CHANGE: server/src/features/jobs/detail/service.ts: in get (JobDetailServiceImpl, 158-171) after loadJob (211-219), when the row is public, open and carries an eligible atsPostingKey, run checkPostingLive with a soft wrapper (the existing soft() helper: a failure never fails the page) and apply the result before the view is built, so a posting the board dropped an hour ago is returned with status 'closed' (view.ts isClosed, line 154; status at 293) and no apply call to action; the feed stops listing it because it is archived. recordApplyClick (495-499) runs the same check first and answers the existing 409 job_closed when the posting is gone, so the user is never sent to a dead page and nothing moves to Applied. server/src/features/jobs/detail/contract.ts: the detail view gains listing: { checkedAt: string | null, via: 'ats_api' | 'sync' | null } next to status. A user's private import and a bank job are never checked this way (the bank tombstone closes those). Web: components/features/job/JobHeader.tsx and JobDetailPanel.tsx show, for status closed, a plain line that the employer's board no longer lists the job (existing closed state; add the sentence that says when it was last listed, from lastSeenAt) and hide the apply button; strings in i18n/staging/jobDetail.en.json.
ACCEPT: The 'Accepted when' of JI-10: opening a job whose ATS endpoint answers 404 shows it closed and archives it (the API returns status 'closed', the page shows the closed line and no apply button, a second open makes no request); an apply click on such a job answers 409 job_closed and creates no tracker move; when the check is unavailable the job opens exactly as today; npm run check passes for the new copy.
TESTS: server/src/features/jobs/detail/detail.test.ts (get and recordApplyClick with a faked liveness dependency: closed, open, unknown, private import untouched), components/features/job/job.test.tsx (closed rendering).
FILES: server/src/features/jobs/detail/service.ts, server/src/features/jobs/detail/defaultService.ts, server/src/features/jobs/detail/view.ts, server/src/features/jobs/detail/contract.ts, server/src/features/jobs/detail/detail.test.ts, components/features/job/JobHeader.tsx, components/features/job/JobDetailPanel.tsx, components/features/job/job.test.tsx, i18n/staging/jobDetail.en.json

[P1] "Ready to apply" checks the posting before a kit is prepared (JI-10; strategy 1.5; D1)
CHANGE: server/src/features/agent/deps.ts (the seams Ready to apply calls, lazily imported public surfaces only): add checkJobLive(jobId): Promise<'open' | 'closed' | 'unknown'> backed by the jobs/liveness public index (it loads the row, runs checkPostingLive and applies the result). server/src/features/agent/service.ts: call it where a job enters the Ready queue and again at the start of preparation, before the existing isJobClosed test (store.ts 172-173; the job_closed transitions at service.ts 673 and 1043): a closed answer follows the existing 'job_closed' path (the item expires, the ready_kits reservation is released, the user is told the job closed); unknown proceeds as today. The check makes one documented JSON request to the ATS's public posting API and never touches an employer's application form (D1 is unchanged: nothing is submitted).
ACCEPT: Adding a job whose posting endpoint answers 404 to the Ready queue is refused with the existing job_closed result and no credit is spent; a kit whose job closes between queueing and preparation expires with job_closed and its reservation is released; with the check unavailable the flow is unchanged.
TESTS: server/src/features/agent/__tests__/liveness.test.ts (new) with the agent's fakes: enqueue and prepare paths for closed / open / unknown.
FILES: server/src/features/agent/deps.ts, server/src/features/agent/service.ts, server/src/features/agent/__tests__/liveness.test.ts (new), server/src/features/jobs/liveness/index.ts

[P1] Three separate date facts everywhere; "New" means first seen by us; an undated posting says "last verified" (JI-10; strategy 1.5 dates; INTL note 7.2)
CHANGE: The row already keeps postedAt (the employer's date, with postedAtEstimated), firstSeenAt (ours) and lastSeenAt (last confirmed listed). Make every surface use them consistently. server/src/features/feed/contract.ts and items.ts (lastSeenAt at 150, postedAtEstimated at 149): the feed item gains firstSeenAt and isNew. ItemContext (items.ts 117-128) gains an optional newSince?: Date | null (the viewer's previous visit, the instant the new-count query already uses); isNew = firstSeenAt is after newSince when the caller supplies it, else after now minus 48 hours (constant NEW_WINDOW_HOURS); it is never derived from postedAt. FeedQueryService.ts is not owned by this bundle: the handoff asks its owner to pass newSince (one argument); until then the 48-hour rule applies, which is still 'first seen by us'. isNew is an item field, not an entry of the badges list (that list is capped at three), and the card model shows its existing 'new' badge from it. server/src/features/jobs/detail/view.ts and contract.ts expose firstSeenAt too. Web: components/features/feed/cardModel.ts builds the date line from these facts: a real postedAt -> 'Posted {relative}'; postedAtEstimated -> 'Last verified {date}' from lastSeenAt (never 'posted'; 台灣就業通 rows and undated mainland rows land here); the New badge only from isNew; JobCard.tsx and JobHeader.tsx render what the model says. A 40-day-old posting first seen today therefore shows its true posted date and a New badge, which is honest for employer boards (their median age is 40 days). Existing strings are reused where they exist ('Last checked'); any new wording goes to i18n/staging/jobDetail.en.json; the card's namespace is not edited by this bundle (if a card string is missing, request it in the handoff).
ACCEPT: A board posting published 300 days ago and first seen an hour ago shows 'Posted 300 days ago' and the New badge; an open-data row (estimated date) shows 'Last verified' with its lastSeenAt and never the word posted; a row first seen before the supplied newSince (or, without one, more than 48 hours ago) has isNew false whatever its posted date; the feed item and the detail view carry all three dates as ISO strings.
TESTS: server/src/features/feed/items.test.ts (firstSeenAt, isNew), server/src/features/jobs/detail/detail.test.ts (view fields), components/features/feed/cardModel.test.ts (the three date-line cases, the badge).
FILES: server/src/features/feed/contract.ts, server/src/features/feed/items.ts, server/src/features/feed/items.test.ts, server/src/features/jobs/detail/view.ts, server/src/features/jobs/detail/contract.ts, components/features/feed/cardModel.ts, components/features/feed/cardModel.test.ts, components/features/feed/JobCard.tsx, components/features/job/JobHeader.tsx

[P1] Mainland rows close by validity, disappearance, or 45 days unseen; missed-refresh tracking stays for aggregators only (JI-10; strategy 1.5 closure, M-22; CN note 8 item 5)
CHANGE: server/src/features/jobs/ingest/maintain.ts runMaintenance (185-207): add step unseenMainland: archive public market 'cn' rows whose lastSeenAt is older than 45 days (constant CN_UNSEEN_DAYS) with closeReason 'expired', for every sourceBoard except user imports; this is the fallback for a mainland source that stopped being read (a disabled board, a bank job the transport no longer returns), after stated validity (expiresAt, MKT-J4) and disappearance from a complete listing (board sync, bank tombstones). It never applies to market intl board or bank rows, which have no age or unseen cut-off. server/src/features/jobs/ingest/tracking.ts: the per-query missed-twice rule (buildMissedSql, 91-100) keeps applying only to metered search providers; confirm in a test that rows of ats_public, the banks, tw_open_data, tw_gov_jobs and usajobs are never selected by it and document in the header that the SR-16b-1 columns now exist in the schema (the probe at 51-66 returns true after the M0 push). Report the new count in MaintainResult.
ACCEPT: A market cn board row not seen for 46 days is archived as expired and one seen 44 days ago is not; an intl board row not seen for 60 days is untouched by this step; a jsearch row missed by two later counted runs inside its window is still archived as source_removed and a board row never is.
TESTS: server/src/features/jobs/ingest/maintain.test.ts (the new statement and its market scope; MaintainResult), a new server/src/features/jobs/ingest/tracking.test.ts for the provider scope of the missed-twice rule.
FILES: server/src/features/jobs/ingest/maintain.ts, server/src/features/jobs/ingest/maintain.test.ts, server/src/features/jobs/ingest/tracking.ts, server/src/features/jobs/ingest/tracking.test.ts (new)

[P1] A job is labelled as sponsoring only with the posting's own quote or as a labelled provider reading (JI-11, JI-7; strategy 1.5 "provider fields first"; INTL note 4.6)
CHANGE: server/src/features/feed/items.ts builds the sponsorship badges today only from RAJob.sponsorship with a posting quote (76-78), shown to users who need sponsorship. MKT-J4 added sponsorshipSource and lets a provider's flag fill sponsorship when no quote exists. Rule for every surface: (a) sponsorship with a non-empty sponsorshipEvidence -> the existing quoted badge, unchanged; (b) sponsorship 'offered' with sponsorshipSource 'provider:<id>' and no quote -> a different badge kind 'sponsorship_provider' whose label says it is the provider's reading and names the provider through the source registry's display name (for example 'Active Jobs DB lists visa sponsorship'), with no quote and never the wording of (a); (c) 'not_offered' from a provider alone -> no badge (a negative needs the posting's words, as today); (d) anything else -> no badge. The same rule in server/src/features/jobs/detail/view.ts for the job page's requirement lines. Company-level history (LCA, USCIS, the UK register: MKT-J15) is a company fact with year, count and source and is never turned into a job-level badge. Add the badge kind to server/src/features/feed/contract.ts; the label text is produced by the web from the kind and the provider name (string in i18n/staging/jobDetail.en.json; the card reuses it).
ACCEPT: The second half of JI-11's 'Accepted when': a row with a posting quote shows the quoted badge; a row whose only signal is the feed's flag shows the provider-reading badge naming the provider and no quote; a provider 'not_offered' alone shows nothing; no row is labelled as sponsoring because its company sponsored before; users who do not need sponsorship still see no sponsorship badge (existing rule).
TESTS: server/src/features/feed/items.test.ts (the four cases), server/src/features/jobs/detail/detail.test.ts (view lines).
FILES: server/src/features/feed/items.ts, server/src/features/feed/contract.ts, server/src/features/feed/items.test.ts, server/src/features/jobs/detail/view.ts, server/src/features/jobs/detail/detail.test.ts, components/features/feed/cardModel.ts, i18n/staging/jobDetail.en.json

bundles.title: New public sources: USAJobs and 事求人, and the source register document
items:
[P1] USAJobs adapter: daily, structured pay and the real close date; disabled without a key (JI-9; strategy 1.2 tier 3, 7 item 3; INTL note 4.2, 6.4)
CHANGE: New server/src/features/jobs/sources/usaJobs.ts: JobSourceAdapter provider 'usajobs' (declared in MKT-J1), kind 'cursor', markets ['intl'], sourceBoards ['usajobs'], costModel 'free', supportsCountry US only. isEnabled = USAJOBS_API_KEY and USAJOBS_USER_AGENT_EMAIL are both set and USAJOBS_DISABLED is not true; export usaJobsStatus(env) -> { enabled } | { enabled: false, reason: 'no_key' | 'disabled' } for the source registry. Request: GET https://data.usajobs.gov/api/Search with DatePosted=1 (7 on the first run, when the cursor is empty), ResultsPerPage=500 and Page=n, with the request headers the official API reference requires (the issued key and the contact e-mail the key was requested with; confirm the header names against https://developer.usajobs.gov/api-reference/get-api-search before coding and cite the doc date in the file header). The cursor is JSON { v: 1, day: 'YYYY-MM-DD', page, firstRunDone }: one page per fetch, exhausted false while a full page came back, then nothing until the next UTC day. Mapping from each search result item (field names from the API reference; the fixture is the documented sample trimmed to two items): externalId 'usajobs:<control number>'; title; company = the hiring organisation / department name; applyUrl = the item's apply URI, else its position URI on usajobs.gov; locations as listed (country US); pay: the remuneration range (minimum, maximum, rate interval code -> year / hour / other periods as documented) in USD as stated; postedAt = publication start date; expiresAt = ApplicationCloseDate (a stated deadline: binding per MKT-J4, the row is archived after it); employmentType from the position schedule; description = the summary and qualification text the search result carries. Eligibility is told honestly: the hiring path (open to the public / federal employees only / veterans …) is stored as a market tag 'usajobs_hiring_path' with the item's own wording as the quote; citizenshipRequired is set true only when the item itself states a citizenship requirement, never by assumption. No applicant counts. Register in server/src/features/jobs/sources/register.ts next to tw_open_data.
ACCEPT: The 'Accepted when' of JI-9: without a key the adapter reports disabled with reason no_key and fetches nothing; with fixtures it maps the pay range (min, max, period, USD) and the close date into expiresAt; the first run asks for 7 days and later runs for 1; a 500-item page answers exhausted false and the next fetch asks for page 2; a federal-employees-only posting carries the hiring-path tag with its quote.
TESTS: server/src/features/jobs/sources/usaJobs.test.ts with server/src/features/jobs/sources/__fixtures__/usajobs/search.json and an injected fetch: status, request parameters and headers (names only, the key value never asserted in output), mapping, paging, daily cadence.
FILES: server/src/features/jobs/sources/usaJobs.ts (new), server/src/features/jobs/sources/usaJobs.test.ts (new), server/src/features/jobs/sources/__fixtures__/usajobs/search.json (new), server/src/features/jobs/sources/register.ts

[P1] 事求人 adapter (public-sector vacancies) without any contact field (JT-9; strategy 1.3; TW note 3.2)
CHANGE: New server/src/features/jobs/sources/twGovJobs.ts: JobSourceAdapter provider 'tw_gov_jobs' (declared in MKT-J1), kind 'cursor', markets ['intl'], sourceBoards ['tw_gov_jobs'], costModel 'free', supportsCountry TW. Dataset 7229 (行政院人事行政總處事求人機關徵才資料, OGDL v1, refreshed at least daily): one XML file, GET https://web3.dgpa.gov.tw/WANT03FRONT/AP/WANTF00003.aspx?GETJOB=Y (about 6.4 MB, about 2,100 rows on 2026-10-11): https only, redirect 'error', 30 s timeout, 20 MB cap, User-Agent sourceUserAgent('intl', env); enabled unless TW_GOV_JOBS_ENABLED is false; URL override TW_GOV_JOBS_URL. One request a day (cursor { v: 1, day }). Parse with a small tolerant element reader (flat records; no new dependency). Mapping: externalId 'dgpa:<id>' where id is the vacancy's own id parameter in VIEW_URL's query string when one is recognisable, else the first 16 hex characters of sha1(VIEW_URL) (stable for as long as the page URL is); a row without VIEW_URL is skipped and counted (no_stable_id); title = TITLE; company = ORG_NAME; applyUrl = sourceUrl = VIEW_URL; location = WORK_PLACE_TYPE (for example '10-臺北市': strip the numeric prefix) plus WORK_ADDRESS, country TW; description = WORK_ITEM and WORK_QUALITY (qualifications; pay points often appear there as text and are left to the normal pay-text reader, never turned into a figure by this adapter); postedAt = DATE_FROM and expiresAt = DATE_TO, both Republic-of-China dates (1151231 = 2026-12-31: year + 1911), end of day Taipei time for the deadline; headcount from NUMBER_OF when numeric. PERSON_KIND decides who may apply: 約僱人員, 聘用人員 and 其他人員 are open to the public and are ingested; 一般人員 posts are transfers for serving civil servants (商調) and are skipped and counted (tw_gov_internal_transfer) unless TW_GOV_JOBS_INCLUDE_TRANSFERS is true, in which case they carry a market tag with the PERSON_KIND text as its quote. NEVER read into any field, log or fixture: VITAE_EMAIL and CONTACT_METHOD (officials' names, e-mail addresses and phone numbers; the licence does not cover third-party privacy): the reader drops both elements before a record object is built. Closure: the file is a complete listing, so ids of our open rows absent from today's file are returned as closedExternalIds ('source_removed'). The OGDL attribution for these rows is already produced by MKT-J6's hook table (key tw_gov_jobs) and rendered by the Taiwan card. Register in server/src/features/jobs/sources/register.ts.
ACCEPT: The 'Accepted when' of JT-9: rows link to VIEW_URL and no e-mail address or phone number is stored (a test scans every produced input and the fixture file for '@' and digit runs taken from the contact fields); DATE_TO 1151231 becomes 2026-12-31 Taipei end of day; a 一般人員 row is skipped and counted by default; a row missing from the next file is closed; the card of such a row shows the 人事行政總處 attribution sentence.
TESTS: server/src/features/jobs/sources/twGovJobs.test.ts with server/src/features/jobs/sources/__fixtures__/twgov/sample.xml (three records hand-built from the documented field list, with obviously fake values in the two contact elements to prove they are dropped): mapping, ROC dates, PERSON_KIND rule, privacy scan, closure, kill switch.
FILES: server/src/features/jobs/sources/twGovJobs.ts (new), server/src/features/jobs/sources/twGovJobs.test.ts (new), server/src/features/jobs/sources/__fixtures__/twgov/sample.xml (new), server/src/features/jobs/sources/register.ts

[P1] Source register: one row per provider with plan, quota, permitted surfaces, attribution, retention and the date read (JI-12; strategy 1.6, 7 item 15; INTL note 8.2 S8)
CHANGE: New docs/job-search/SOURCE_REGISTER.md. One table row per provider id that can write a job row: ats_public (per ATS: Greenhouse, Lever incl. EU, Ashby, SmartRecruiters, Workable, Recruitee, Personio, 北森 behind its flag), bank_robohire, bank_gohire, activejobs (search and feed), jsearch, tw_open_data, tw_gov_jobs, usajobs, user_import. Columns: provider id; what it is and who publishes it; plan and quota as known on the date read (for example Active Jobs DB: BASIC, 25 requests and 250 jobs a month on 2026-10-11; JSearch: 10,000 requests a month); permitted surfaces (signed-in users / public indexable pages / partner API), each with its basis: OGDL v1 permits public redisplay for the two Taiwan datasets; Fantastic.jobs terms 9.1-9.2 allow showing matched jobs to our own users and public pages are an open written question; JSearch redisplay rights are unresolved, so signed-in only; employer boards: signed-in, public display awaits counsel; USAJobs: official API; required attribution text (the two OGDL sentences verbatim; 'never LinkedIn branding' for aggregators); retention on termination when the terms state one, otherwise 'not stated'; primary URL of the terms; date read; owner decision pending. Take every fact from the research notes (JOB_SOURCES_INTL, _TW, _CN and MARKET_STRATEGY 1.6, 7) and write 'not stated' or 'unresolved' where they say so: no licence, price or quota may be invented (D3). A second section lists the forbidden sources of strategy 1.6 with the reason, and a third the env switch per source. State which providers are candidates for PUBLIC_DISPLAY_PROVIDERS (tw_open_data and usajobs are the recommended first entries) and that the default stays empty until the owner decides. server/src/features/jobs/sources/sourceRegister.test.ts parses the table and fails when a provider id in PROVIDER_META (server/src/features/jobs/normalize/source.ts) has no row, when a row lacks a date read, or when a forbidden host of 1.6 appears as a provider.
ACCEPT: The 'Accepted when' of JI-12: one row per provider with plan, quota, permitted surfaces, attribution, retention and date read; the test passes and fails when a new provider id is added without a row; the document names no source the strategy forbids as usable and invents no number (every figure is traceable to a research note section, cited in the row).
TESTS: server/src/features/jobs/sources/sourceRegister.test.ts (new; reads the Markdown file from disk, no network).
FILES: docs/job-search/SOURCE_REGISTER.md (new), server/src/features/jobs/sources/sourceRegister.test.ts (new)
env: USAJOBS_API_KEY: free key from developer.usajobs.gov; without it the adapter is disabled (unset)
USAJOBS_USER_AGENT_EMAIL: the contact e-mail the key was issued to, sent as the API requires (unset)
USAJOBS_DISABLED: true turns the adapter off (false)
TW_GOV_JOBS_ENABLED: false turns the 事求人 adapter off (on)
TW_GOV_JOBS_URL: dataset URL override (the documented endpoint)
TW_GOV_JOBS_INCLUDE_TRANSFERS: true also ingests 一般人員 transfer posts, tagged (false)

bundles.title: GoHire bank over the syndication endpoint: hardened HTTP adapter, mirror read for live cross-bank search, the contract for the second repository
items:
[P0] Syndication wire contract, validated before anything is logged or stored (JC-2, JC-3 this repository's side; strategy 1.4 tier 1, 8 "GoHire bank transport"; CN note 2.3 option B)
CHANGE: The parity wave (PAR-7) added an HTTPS reader for the GoHire bank and a first variant for GOHIRE_SYNDICATION_URL. This item fixes the contract in code so the endpoint in the GoHire backend (second repository, JC-3) and this adapter are built against the same shape. New server/src/features/jobs/ingest/adapters/syndication.ts: zod schemas SyndicatedJobSchema = exactly the columns of BANK_SYNC_SELECT (server/src/features/jobs/ingest/adapters/bank.ts 33-57: id, status, publishedAt, updatedAt, title, description, qualifications, hardRequirements, niceToHave, benefits, location, locations, workType, employmentType, experienceLevel, salaryMin, salaryMax, salaryCurrency, salaryPeriod, salaryText, companyName, requiredKeywordSet, company { id, name, logoUrl, website, industry, size, headcount, founded }) plus the two fields the parity wave reads (education, headcount) plus employerVerified: boolean, syndicationConsentAt: ISO string | null, validFrom: ISO string | null, validUntil: ISO string | null; SyndicationPageSchema = { items: SyndicatedJob[], tombstones: Array<{ id: string, updatedAt: ISO string, reason?: string }>, nextCursor: string | null, hasMore: boolean }. Parsing strips every unknown key (recruiter notes, evaluation rules, AI caches, tenant data can never pass, whatever the server sends) and a page that fails validation is an error result, not a partial write. Export toBankSyncRow(job) so the existing mapping (inputFromBankSyncRow, 142-186) and quality gates (isSyncableBankJob, the named-employer rule, the parity wave's bank_unpublished / bank_no_company / bank_test_posting tallies) are reused unchanged. Nothing in a validation error message quotes the payload.
ACCEPT: A page with an extra field 'notes' on a job parses and the field is absent from the result and from every log line (logger spy); a page missing 'items' or with a non-ISO updatedAt is rejected as one error; toBankSyncRow output passes isSyncableBankJob for an open published job and the same inputFromBankSyncRow mapping as a database row with the same values (deep-equal test).
TESTS: server/src/features/jobs/ingest/adapters/syndication.test.ts: schema acceptance and rejection table, key stripping, equivalence with the database reader's row shape.
FILES: server/src/features/jobs/ingest/adapters/syndication.ts (new), server/src/features/jobs/ingest/adapters/syndication.test.ts (new), server/src/features/jobs/ingest/adapters/bank.ts

[P0] HTTP variant of the bank adapter: cursor sync with tombstones, verified-employer and consent fields, validity, TLS only (JC-2; strategy 1.4 tier 1, 1.5; CN note 2.3, 5.2)
CHANGE: server/src/features/jobs/ingest/adapters/bank.ts: behind the BankPageReader seam (line 189) the syndication reader becomes the transport whenever GOHIRE_SYNDICATION_URL is set (it wins over the parity wave's list reader and over the database transport; GOHIRE_BANK_TRANSPORT=off still disables the bank). Request: GET <GOHIRE_SYNDICATION_URL>?cursor=<updatedAt ISO|id>&limit=<INGEST_BANK_PAGE, default 200>; the URL must be https (localhost and 127.0.0.1 are exempt for tests and a dev tunnel; anything else answers error 'syndication_url_not_https' and no request is made); authentication with the service key GOHIRE_SYNDICATION_KEY, falling back to GOHIRE_API_KEY, in the same header the existing GoHire client of this repo sends (server/src/services/GoHireResumeParseService.ts); 20 s timeout; response cap 5 MB; redirect 'error'. Result mapping to SourceFetchResult: items -> jobs through toBankSyncRow and the existing gates; tombstones -> closedExternalIds (closeReason 'bank_closed', the default; the upsert revives a job the bank publishes again); cursor = nextCursor, rejected with error 'cursor_regressed' when it sorts before the cursor sent; exhausted = !hasMore. Fields: employerVerified true is the only thing that lets a row carry 企业直招 (and only when it is not an agency: unchanged rule); syndicationConsentAt non-null sets publicDisplay (the consent to syndicate, OPS-A4) and null keeps the row for signed-in users only; validUntil -> ProviderJobInput.expiresAt (MKT-J4 honours a stated validity for bank rows; mainland naive times are UTC+8 but this endpoint must send ISO with an offset, so a zone-less value is treated as UTC+8 and counted in a tally). Rows are market cn, sourceBoard 'gohire', priority 3 (MKT-J4), apply URL = the GoHire page (synthesizeApplyUrl). server/src/roboapply/v2/lib/raBankClients.ts isBankEnabled (43-54): reports the bank enabled with transport 'syndication' when the URL and a key are set, without requiring any database URL; the TLS rule for the database transport (bankTlsSatisfied, 68-79) is untouched. Never throws; an error string carries the status code and a short reason, never the URL's query, the key or a body excerpt.
ACCEPT: The 'Accepted when' of JC-2: with GOHIRE_SYNDICATION_URL pointing at an in-process stub server (node:http on 127.0.0.1) a cursor sync over two pages upserts the rows into market cn and a tombstone archives one stored row as bank_closed; a job with employerVerified true and no agency flag may carry 企业直招 and one without may not; a job without syndicationConsentAt has publicDisplay false; validUntil becomes expiresAt; an http:// URL on a public host is refused without a request; a regressed cursor, a 401 and a 6 MB body each give an error result and write nothing; with the variable unset the parity wave's transports behave exactly as before (their tests are unchanged).
TESTS: server/src/features/jobs/ingest/adapters/adapters.test.ts and a new section in syndication.test.ts using the stub server or an injected fetch (no external network): paging, tombstones, field effects, the refusal cases, key and URL never logged (logger spy).
FILES: server/src/features/jobs/ingest/adapters/bank.ts, server/src/features/jobs/ingest/adapters/syndication.ts, server/src/features/jobs/ingest/adapters/syndication.test.ts, server/src/features/jobs/ingest/adapters/adapters.test.ts, server/src/roboapply/v2/lib/raBankClients.ts

[P1] Live cross-bank search reads the synced mirror whenever the GoHire bank is reached over HTTP (JC-2; strategy 1.4; CN note 2.1, 2.3)
CHANGE: server/src/roboapply/v2/lib/raBankProviders.ts and server/src/roboapply/v2/services/RACrossBankSearchService.ts run a live findMany on the recruiter database (OR over title, description and tag sets, status open, fresh). With the HTTP transports there is no database client for GoHire, and none must ever be opened in plaintext. Rule: when the GoHire transport is 'api' or 'syndication' (isBankEnabled reports it), the GoHire leg of a cross-bank search queries our own RAJob mirror instead: market 'cn', sourceBoard 'gohire', visibility 'public', archivedAt null, isCanonical true, the same title / description / skills predicates, the same freshness bound, mapped to the bank-job shape the matcher expects (id = RAJob.externalId, the recruiter Job.id). The parity wave did this 'when no database client exists'; make it depend on the transport, so a configured but non-TLS database URL can never be chosen for search while sync runs over HTTP, and add the mirror's sync age (the newest lastSeenAt of gohire rows) to the search telemetry so a stale mirror is visible. The RoboHire leg and the database transport are unchanged. Never throws (existing contract).
ACCEPT: With transport syndication a GoHire cross-bank search returns rows from the mirror, makes zero calls to getBankClient('gohire') (spy) and zero HTTP calls; with the database transport it queries the bank as before; an empty mirror returns an empty list, not an error; the result items carry the recruiter job id so materialisation keys stay the same.
TESTS: server/src/roboapply/v2/lib/raBankProviders.test.ts and server/src/roboapply/v2/services/RACrossBankSearchService.test.ts with fake clients: transport switch, no client opened, mapping.
FILES: server/src/roboapply/v2/lib/raBankProviders.ts, server/src/roboapply/v2/lib/raBankProviders.test.ts, server/src/roboapply/v2/services/RACrossBankSearchService.ts, server/src/roboapply/v2/services/RACrossBankSearchService.test.ts, server/src/roboapply/v2/lib/raBankClients.ts

[P1] The endpoint contract and work package for the GoHire backend, and a read-only probe the owner can run (JC-3 this repository's side; strategy 7 items 9-10)
CHANGE: New docs/jobright-clone/market/GOHIRE_SYNDICATION.md, written for the engineer who builds the route in the RoboHire / GoHire backend (the second repository; no code of that repository is changed from here): route GET /api/v1/syndication/jobs?cursor=<updatedAt|id>&limit<=200 on the host that already serves valid TLS (api.gohire.top); authentication by a service key with a new scope limited to this route (an ordinary user key lists only that user's jobs and must not work here); response exactly SyndicationPageSchema of the previous items (field list copied from the schema file, which stays the source of truth); semantics: only jobs that are open AND published, ordered by (updatedAt, id), tombstones for jobs that were closed, unpublished, re-drafted or lost consent since the cursor, employerVerified from the verified-employer record (re-verified at least every six months per the five-ministry notice), syndicationConsentAt from the employer's recorded consent, validUntil from the posting's validity period, timestamps in ISO 8601 with offset; never internal notes, evaluation rules, candidate or recruiter personal data; rate: one request every few seconds is enough (cursor sync every 10 minutes); errors as JSON with a code. Add the acceptance list for the owner's side (the route returns the agreed columns over TLS with a scoped key; test postings such as titles containing 测试 or an empty company are not published), the schema additions the bank needs (employerVerified, syndicationConsentAt, validity), and the env to set here (GOHIRE_SYNDICATION_URL, GOHIRE_SYNDICATION_KEY). Also record what this repo falls back to until the route exists (the parity wave's list reader, which sees only the jobs the service key's user may see). New scripts/gohire-syndication-probe.mjs (run by the owner, never by CI): one GET of the first page with the configured URL and key, validated with the same schema (import the built schema or a small copy kept in sync by a test), printing only counts (items, tombstones, how many verified, how many with consent, how many with validity), the page's cursor and schema problems by field name; it prints no job text, no company name and no key.
ACCEPT: The document lets an engineer with no other context build the route (every field, the ordering, tombstone rules, auth scope and error shape are stated) and names the owner steps of strategy 7 items 9-10; the probe run against the stub server prints counts and exits 0, prints schema problems and exits 1 for a bad page, and its output contains no value from the payload other than counts and the cursor (test).
TESTS: A unit test for the probe's summariser inside server/src/features/jobs/ingest/adapters/syndication.test.ts (pure function imported from the script or shared module; no network).
FILES: docs/jobright-clone/market/GOHIRE_SYNDICATION.md (new), scripts/gohire-syndication-probe.mjs (new), server/src/features/jobs/ingest/adapters/syndication.ts, server/src/features/jobs/ingest/adapters/syndication.test.ts
env: GOHIRE_SYNDICATION_URL: the GoHire syndication endpoint; when set it is the bank transport (unset: the parity wave's transports)
GOHIRE_SYNDICATION_KEY: scoped service key for that endpoint (falls back to GOHIRE_API_KEY)
GOHIRE_BANK_TRANSPORT: db | api | off, from the parity wave; syndication is implied by GOHIRE_SYNDICATION_URL

bundles.title: Taiwan extras: pay-rule note from config, district level and shift pattern with their filters, provenance and helper text
items:
[P1] The pay-disclosure note takes its threshold, source link and as-of date from AppConfig (JT-6; strategy 1.3, 1.5 pay; TW note 4)
CHANGE: The note that explains why a 面議 posting may omit pay names the statutory threshold, and the Ministry of Labor has announced a change from NT$40,000 to about NT$50,000 (not passed, no date). New server/src/features/tw/payRule.ts, modelled on server/src/platform/billing/fxReference.ts: AppConfig key 'tw.payRule.v1' with value { thresholdTwd: number, lawLabel: string, sourceUrl: string, asOf: 'YYYY-MM-DD', updatedAt, updatedBy }; when the row is missing the default is the law in force as read on 2026-10-11: { thresholdTwd: 40000, lawLabel: '就業服務法第5條第2項第6款', sourceUrl: 'https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=N0090001&flno=5', asOf: '2026-10-11' }. readTwPayRule(db) and saveTwPayRule(db, input, adminId) with validation (threshold 10,000-200,000 in whole thousands, https source URL, a real date not in the future). Routes in a new server/src/features/tw/routes.ts mounted from server/src/features/index.ts: GET /api/v1/roboapply/tw/pay-rule (any signed-in or public page of the intl brand; cache 5 minutes) and PUT /api/v1/roboapply/admin/tw/pay-rule (admin; audit-logged through the existing admin audit helper); both answer 404 feature_disabled on GoApply. Web: lib/api/tw.ts wrapper; components/features/market/tw/NegotiablePayNote.tsx reads the rule and renders the sentence with the amount (NT$ with thousands separator), the as-of date and the source link from the response; the string in i18n/staging/jobsTw.en.json takes {amount} and {asOf} placeholders and no number is left in any bundle. The note keeps saying what it says today: it explains the rule and never states or implies that THIS job pays the threshold; the threshold is never shown as a job's pay, never used as a filter value and never written to a job row (MKT-J1 already made the parser threshold-agnostic).
ACCEPT: The 'Accepted when' of JT-6: changing the AppConfig value to 50,000 with a new as-of date changes the note on the next load without a deploy; with no row the note shows NT$40,000, the law link and 2026-10-11; a job card or job page never shows the threshold as that job's pay (test over the card model for a negotiable posting); an invalid PUT (threshold 45,500, http URL, future date) is refused; the copy gate passes and no locale bundle contains '40,000' or '4萬'.
TESTS: server/src/features/tw/payRule.test.ts (new): default, parse, validation, save; a route test with fake auth; components/features/market/tw/__tests__/twExtras.test.tsx: the note renders config values and the default.
FILES: server/src/features/tw/payRule.ts (new), server/src/features/tw/payRule.test.ts (new), server/src/features/tw/routes.ts (new), server/src/features/tw/index.ts, server/src/features/index.ts, lib/api/tw.ts (new), components/features/market/tw/NegotiablePayNote.tsx, components/features/market/tw/__tests__/twExtras.test.tsx (new), i18n/staging/jobsTw.en.json

[P1] District level on Taiwan job rows (JT-7; strategy 2.5; TW note 5.3, 6 item 7)
CHANGE: Live strings such as 新竹縣竹北市, 苗栗縣竹南鎮, 台中市西屯區 and 臺南市善化區 resolve to the right city today but the district is discarded. server/src/features/jobs/geo/parseLocation.ts (parseLocation, line 153): ParsedLocation gains district: string | null, filled for country TW from findTwDistrict (MKT-J6's server/src/features/jobs/geo/twDistricts.ts: county + 鄉鎮市區, both 台 and 臺 forms; '不限' means the whole county and gives no district); other countries always null. The existing '• 透過「104人力銀行」' suffix handling stays. server/src/features/jobs/normalize/normalizeProviderJob.ts: locationDistrict = the input's own locationDistrict (a source that states it) else the primary parsed location's district, only when the resolved country is TW (MKT-J4 already carries the field to the row and the M0 schema has the column and its index). server/src/features/jobs/sources/twOpenData.ts passes the district of CITYNAME explicitly. Stored value: the district name as posted in Traditional Chinese with its county prefix removed (for example '竹北市'); the county is the row's city / region as today. Expose GET /api/v1/roboapply/tw/districts (in server/src/features/tw/routes.ts, cacheable) returning counties with their districts from the table, for the filter UI; names are data, not copy.
ACCEPT: The first clause of JT-7's 'Accepted when': '新竹縣竹北市' resolves to county 新竹縣 and district 竹北市 and a row ingested with that location stores locationDistrict '竹北市'; '臺北市士林區 • 透過「104人力銀行」' stores 士林區; '台中市不限' stores no district; a location outside Taiwan never gets a district; the districts endpoint lists the 22 counties.
TESTS: server/src/features/jobs/geo/geo.test.ts (district cases), server/src/features/jobs/normalize/normalizeProviderJob.test.ts (row field), server/src/features/jobs/sources/twOpenData.test.ts (adapter passes it).
FILES: server/src/features/jobs/geo/parseLocation.ts, server/src/features/jobs/geo/index.ts, server/src/features/jobs/geo/geo.test.ts, server/src/features/jobs/normalize/normalizeProviderJob.ts, server/src/features/jobs/normalize/normalizeProviderJob.test.ts, server/src/features/jobs/sources/twOpenData.ts, server/src/features/jobs/sources/twOpenData.test.ts, server/src/features/tw/routes.ts

CHANGE: The DOL LCA loader exists and stays as it is (server/src/features/jobs/data/lca.ts, importLca.ts, table RAH1bEmployerStat; its tests must still pass). Add beside it server/src/features/jobs/data/uscis.ts and importUscis.ts for the USCIS H-1B Employer Data Hub export (one CSV per fiscal year, public record). The research did not open the official page, so the importer maps columns by header name and fails loudly on a file whose header it does not recognise: required headers are the fiscal year, the employer (petitioner) name and the four counts (initial approvals, initial denials, continuing approvals, continuing denials); confirm the exact header spellings against a file downloaded from the hub and record them, with the download URL and date, in the module header and in a three-row fixture built from that header (employer names in the fixture are invented placeholders such as 'EXAMPLE EMPLOYER LLC'; no real row is committed). parseUscisRow -> { fiscalYear, employerName, approvals = initial + continuing approvals, denials = initial + continuing denials }; aggregate per normalised employer name (the same normalizeCompanyName the LCA loader uses) and fiscal year; upsert into the new table RASponsorRegisterEntry (M0 schema bundle) with source 'uscis_h1b_hub', country 'US', period 'FY<year>', sourceFile = the file name, sourceUrl = the hub URL, asOf = the file's publication date given on the command line. CLI: tsx server/src/features/jobs/data/importUscis.ts <file.csv> --as-of YYYY-MM-DD [--dry-run], streaming with csv-parse; it is run by the owner or ops against the chosen database, never by a work-package agent and never in CI. No government file is committed to the repo.
